text.zh: DNA 是攜帶遺傳資訊的分子，由 A、C、G、T 四種鹼基組成；A 與 T 配對、C 與 G 配對。
text.en: DNA is the molecule that carries genetic information; it uses four bases (A, C, G, T), with A pairing with T and C pairing with G.

text.zh: RNA 與 DNA 結構相似，但多為單股、骨架使用核糖（ribose），並以尿嘧啶（U）取代胸腺嘧啶（T）；細胞中有 mRNA、rRNA、tRNA 等，部分 RNA 參與基因表現調控。
text.en: RNA resembles DNA but is most often single-stranded, uses ribose instead of deoxyribose, and uses uracil (U) instead of thymine (T); cells contain mRNA, rRNA and tRNA, and some RNAs regulate gene expression.

text.zh: 染色體是由蛋白質與一條 DNA 分子組成的線狀結構；人類有 22 對體染色體與 1 對性染色體，共 46 條。
text.en: A chromosome is a threadlike structure of protein and a single DNA molecule; humans have 22 pairs of autosomes and one pair of sex chromosomes, 46 in total.

text.zh: 基因是遺傳的基本單位，多數基因編碼蛋白質；人類約有 20,000 個蛋白質編碼基因。
text.en: The gene is the basic unit of inheritance; most genes code for proteins, and humans have approximately 20,000 protein-coding genes.

text.zh: Locus（基因座）是基因體中的一個實體位置，例如一個基因或其他 DNA 片段，類似街道地址；複數為 loci。
text.en: A locus is a physical site in a genome, such as a gene or another DNA segment, somewhat like a street address; the plural is loci.

text.zh: Allele（對偶基因）是同一基因體位置上的不同 DNA 序列版本；每個人在該位置從父母各得一個 allele，兩者相同為同型合子（homozygous），不同為異型合子（heterozygous）。
text.en: An allele is one of two or more versions of DNA sequence at a given genomic location; an individual inherits two alleles, one from each parent — identical alleles make the individual homozygous, different alleles heterozygous.

text.zh: SNP（單核苷酸多態性）是發生在單一鹼基位置的基因體變異，研究者探討 SNP 是否及如何影響健康、疾病、藥物反應與其他性狀。
text.en: A single nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) is a genomic variant at a single base position; scientists study if and how SNPs influence health, disease, drug response and other traits.

text.zh: 1000 Genomes Project 重建了 26 個族群、2,504 人的基因體，共描述超過 8,800 萬個變異（約 8,470 萬個 SNP、360 萬個短插入/刪除與 6 萬個結構變異）。
text.en: The 1000 Genomes Project reconstructed the genomes of 2,504 individuals from 26 populations and characterized over 88 million variants (84.7 million SNPs, 3.6 million short indels and 60,000 structural variants).

text.zh: Genotype（基因型）是對某一基因座上變異類型的判定；部分基因型會影響個體可觀察的性狀，即 phenotype。
text.en: A genotype is a scoring of the type of variant present at a given locus; some genotypes contribute to an individual's observable traits, called the phenotype.

text.zh: Phenotype（表現型）是個體可觀察的性狀，例如身高、眼睛顏色與血型；它同時由基因型與環境因素決定。
text.en: Phenotype refers to an individual's observable traits, such as height, eye colour and blood type, and is determined by both genotype and environmental factors.

text.zh: 人類基因體計畫完成後，定序技術進步使每百萬鹼基成本下降、已定序基因體數量增加；有些方法追求單位時間內最多鹼基，有些則追求更長的連續讀段以解析結構複雜區域。
text.en: Since the Human Genome Project, sequencing advances have lowered the cost per megabase and increased the number of sequenced genomes; some approaches maximize bases per unit time while others sequence longer contiguous DNA to resolve structurally complex regions.

claims.note: Time-sensitive: describes the 2016 state of the field; costs and throughput of long-read platforms have changed since.

text.zh: （截至 2016 年）長讀段定序克服了讀段長度限制，但成本明顯較高、通量較低，限制了其普及。此描述具時效性。
text.en: (As of 2016) long-read sequencing overcomes read-length limits but was considerably more expensive and lower-throughput, limiting adoption. This statement is time-sensitive.

evidence.location: Main text, section on long-read sequencing

text.zh: Exome（外顯子體）是基因體中所有外顯子的序列，代表蛋白質編碼部分，約占人類基因體的 1.5%。
text.en: The exome is the sequence of all exons in a genome — the protein-coding portion — and is about 1.5% of the human genome.

text.zh: 1000 Genomes Project 結合低覆蓋度全基因體定序、深度外顯子定序與高密度微陣列基因分型，說明 WGS、WES 與 array 可互補使用，而非只能擇一。
text.en: The 1000 Genomes Project combined low-coverage whole-genome sequencing, deep exome sequencing and dense microarray genotyping — WGS, WES and arrays can be used together rather than only one at a time.

text.zh: VCF（Variant Call Format）是儲存 SNP、插入/刪除與結構變異及其註解的通用格式，通常壓縮並建立索引以快速查詢；最初為 1000 Genomes Project 開發。
text.en: The Variant Call Format (VCF) is a generic format for storing SNPs, indels and structural variants with annotations; it is usually compressed and indexed for fast retrieval and was developed for the 1000 Genomes Project.

text.zh: GATK 是為 NGS 資料設計的分析框架，提供覆蓋度計算與 SNP calling 等工具，已用於 1000 Genomes Project 與 TCGA 等大型計畫。
text.en: GATK is an analysis framework for next-generation sequencing data, providing tools such as coverage calculators and SNP calling, used in large projects including the 1000 Genomes Project and TCGA.

text.zh: 遺傳性（germline）變異由父母傳給子女，存在於幾乎所有細胞；後天（somatic）變異在生命中某時發生，只存在部分細胞，且不會遺傳給下一代。
text.en: Hereditary (germline) variants are passed from parent to child and are present in virtually every cell; acquired (somatic) variants arise during life, are present only in some cells, and cannot be passed to the next generation.

evidence.location: Page "What is a gene variant and how do variants occur?"

text.zh: T2T Consortium 發表完整的 30.55 億鹼基對人類基因體 T2T-CHM13，補上先前參考基因體缺少的約 8%，除 Y 染色體外所有染色體皆無缺口。
text.en: The T2T Consortium presented T2T-CHM13, a complete 3.055-billion-base-pair human genome that adds the ~8% missing from earlier references, with gapless assemblies for all chromosomes except Y.

text.zh: ACMG/AMP 建議以 pathogenic、likely pathogenic、uncertain significance、likely benign、benign 五級術語描述孟德爾疾病基因中的變異，並依族群、計算、功能、共分離等證據分類。
text.en: ACMG/AMP recommend five terms — pathogenic, likely pathogenic, uncertain significance, likely benign, benign — for variants in Mendelian disease genes, classified using population, computational, functional and segregation evidence.

text.zh: RNA-seq 以深度定序技術分析轉錄體，相較其他方法能更精確測量轉錄本及其 isoform 的量。
text.en: RNA-seq profiles the transcriptome with deep-sequencing technologies and measures transcript and isoform levels more precisely than other methods.

text.zh: 沒有一條 RNA-seq 分析流程適用所有情境；主要步驟包含實驗設計、品質控制、比對、定量、差異表現、選擇性剪接、功能分析與 eQTL mapping 等。
text.en: No single RNA-seq analysis pipeline fits all cases; major steps include experimental design, quality control, alignment, quantification, differential expression, alternative splicing, functional analysis and eQTL mapping.

text.zh: Wagner 等人指出 RPKM 在不同樣本間不一致，提出修正版 TPM（transcripts per million），使樣本內平均相對莫耳濃度維持不變。
text.en: Wagner et al. showed that RPKM is inconsistent among samples and proposed TPM (transcripts per million), which respects the invariance of average relative molar concentration.

text.zh: 單看讀段數不足以比較不同樣本的表現量，因為讀段數受轉錄本長度、總讀段數與定序偏差影響，需要正規化。
text.en: Read counts alone are not sufficient to compare expression among samples, because they depend on transcript length, total number of reads and sequencing biases; normalization is needed.

text.zh: 差異表現分析面對重複數少、離散計數、動態範圍大與離群值等問題；DESeq2 以收縮估計（shrinkage）穩定 dispersion 與 fold change 的估計。
text.en: Differential expression analysis faces small replicate numbers, discrete counts, large dynamic range and outliers; DESeq2 uses shrinkage estimation of dispersions and fold changes to stabilize estimates.

text.zh: 差異分析的輸入是計數資料，例如 RNA-seq 中每個基因的讀段數，並比較不同實驗條件之間的系統性變化。
text.en: Differential analysis takes count data — such as read counts per gene in RNA-seq — and tests for systematic changes across experimental conditions.

text.zh: RNA-seq 研究已改變我們對真核生物轉錄體範圍與複雜度的認識。
text.en: Studies using RNA-seq have altered our view of the extent and complexity of eukaryotic transcriptomes.

text.zh: GWAS 在大量個體的基因體中檢測數十萬個變異，找出與特定性狀或疾病「統計上相關」的變異。
text.en: GWAS test hundreds of thousands of genetic variants across many genomes to find those statistically associated with a specific trait or disease.

text.zh: GWAS 結果可用於理解性狀生物學、估計遺傳率、計算遺傳相關、臨床風險預測、藥物開發，以及推論風險因子與健康結果之間可能的因果關係。
text.en: GWAS results are used to gain insight into a phenotype's biology, estimate heritability, calculate genetic correlations, make clinical risk predictions, inform drug development and infer potential causal relationships between risk factors and outcomes.

text.zh: GWAS 常用的全基因體顯著閾值為 p < 5 × 10⁻⁸；Visscher 等人（2017）統計約 10,000 個以此標準定義的強關聯。
text.en: GWAS conventionally use a genome-wide significance threshold of p < 5 × 10⁻⁸; Visscher et al. (2017) counted about 10,000 strong associations defined this way.

evidence.location: Main text, section "Discoveries" (definition of strong association)

text.zh: Linkage disequilibrium（LD）是不同基因座上 allele 的非隨機關聯，受重組、天擇、遺傳漂變與突變影響，被用來定位與性狀或疾病相關的基因。
text.en: Linkage disequilibrium (LD) is the nonrandom association of alleles at different loci; it is shaped by recombination, selection, drift and mutation, and is used to map genes associated with traits and diseases.

text.zh: 關聯不等於因果：GWAS 找到的顯著 SNP 通常透過 LD 標記附近未知的因果變異，之後仍需搜尋附近直接影響性狀的變異。
text.en: Association is not causation: a significant GWAS SNP often tags unknown causal variants through LD, and nearby variants that directly contribute to the trait must still be searched for.

evidence.location: Main text, discussion of power and LD (r²) between genotyped and unknown causal variants
Glossary entry "Genome-Wide Association Studies (GWAS)" (definition and narration: correlation, not causation)

text.zh: 在二元（病例/對照）性狀中，GWAS 回報的效應量通常是 odds ratio；用於計算 PRS 時會取 log(OR) 作為權重。
text.en: For binary (case/control) phenotypes, GWAS effect sizes are typically reported as odds ratios, and log(OR) is used as the weight when calculating PRS.

evidence.location: Main text, section on effect size / PRS calculation

claims.note: Snapshot counts as of the 2023 database paper.

text.zh: NHGRI-EBI GWAS Catalog 收錄超過 45,000 篇已發表 GWAS、5,000 多種人類性狀的變異—性狀關聯，以及超過 40,000 組完整 summary statistics（2023 年資料）。
text.en: The NHGRI-EBI GWAS Catalog contains variant–trait associations for >45,000 published GWAS across >5,000 human traits and >40,000 full summary-statistics datasets (as of 2023).

text.zh: 2009 年分析顯示 96% 的 GWAS 參與者為歐洲血統；2016 年非歐洲比例增至近 20%，但成長多來自亞洲族群，非洲、拉丁美洲、西語裔與原住民合計仍不到 4%。
text.en: A 2009 analysis found 96% of GWAS participants were of European descent; by 2016 non-European participants rose to nearly 20%, mostly from Asian populations, while African, Latin American, Hispanic and indigenous peoples together were under 4%.

claims.missing_evidence: No verified source in the current corpus describes the Manhattan plot axes (genomic position vs −log10 p). S12 (Uffelmann 2021) likely does, but its full text could not be retrieved for verification. Needs a human-approved source (e.g. replace one source or raise the source cap).

text.zh: 曼哈頓圖以 x 軸表示染色體位置、y 軸表示 −log₁₀(p)，每個點代表一個 SNP。
text.en: A Manhattan plot shows genomic position on the x-axis and −log10(p) on the y-axis, one point per SNP.

text.zh: PRS（多基因風險分數）是根據個體基因型與 GWAS 資料計算、估計其對某性狀或疾病遺傳傾向（genetic liability）的分數；目前的 PRS 通常只解釋性狀變異的一小部分。
text.en: A polygenic risk score (PRS) estimates an individual's genetic liability to a trait or disease from their genotype profile and GWAS data; current PRSs typically explain only a small fraction of trait variance.

text.zh: 標準 PRS 是個體風險 allele 的加總，並以 GWAS 估計的效應量加權：PRS = Σ βᵢ × Gᵢ。
text.en: A standard PRS is the sum of an individual's risk alleles weighted by GWAS effect size estimates: PRS = Σ βᵢ × Gᵢ.

evidence.location: Introduction (definition of PRS as weighted sum)

text.zh: 常見的「標準方法」是 C+T（clumping + thresholding）：以 clumping 處理 LD，再依 P 值門檻篩選 SNP；另有 LASSO、BLUP 等收縮方法。
text.en: The standard approach is C+T (clumping + thresholding): LD is handled by clumping and SNPs are selected by P-value threshold; shrinkage methods such as LASSO or BLUP are alternatives.

text.zh: 目前的 PRS 在歐洲血統個體中準確度高出數倍，原因是 GWAS 以歐洲族群為主；若直接用於臨床，可能擴大健康不平等。
text.en: Current PRSs are several times more accurate in individuals of European ancestry because GWAS are Eurocentric; using them clinically as-is may exacerbate health disparities.

text.zh: PGS Catalog 是公開資料庫，收錄已發表分數的變異、allele 與權重，以及可重現所需的標準化 metadata。
text.en: The PGS Catalog is an open resource of published scores — variants, alleles and weights — with consistently curated metadata for reproducibility.

text.zh: Khera 等人在 UK Biobank（英國血統參與者）建立並驗證五種疾病的全基因體 PRS，可找出 8.0%（冠狀動脈疾病）到 1.5%（乳癌）的人口具三倍以上風險。
text.en: Khera et al. developed and validated genome-wide PRS for five diseases in UK Biobank participants of British ancestry, identifying 8.0% (coronary artery disease) to 1.5% (breast cancer) of the population at >3-fold risk.

evidence.location: Abstract; Methods (UK Biobank, 409,258 participants of British ancestry)

text.zh: PRS 驗證時，base（GWAS）資料與 target 資料不能有樣本重疊，否則 PRS 與性狀的關聯會被嚴重高估。
text.en: When validating a PRS, sample overlap between base (GWAS) and target data must be eliminated, because it can substantially inflate the PRS–trait association.

evidence.location: Section on QC of base and target data, "Sample overlap"

text.zh: 每人在一個位置有兩個 allele（父母各一），因此某 effect allele 的劑量（dosage）為 0、1 或 2；PRS 即加總這些 allele 並以效應量加權。
text.en: Each person carries two alleles at a location (one from each parent), so the dosage of an effect allele is 0, 1 or 2; a PRS sums these alleles weighted by effect size.

evidence.location: Introduction (sum of risk alleles weighted by effect size)

text.zh: PRS 的個人與臨床效用仍有爭議：早期認為用 DNA 預測疾病幾乎沒有幫助，近期研究則顯示可用於找出可能受益的族群（群體層級分層）。
text.en: The personal and clinical utility of PRS is debated: early work judged DNA-based prediction to add little, while recent efforts show utility for identifying groups who could benefit (group-level stratification).

text.zh: PRS 研究多以「相對風險」（例如比其餘人口高三倍）表達結果；作者也指出臨床上需同時評估與溝通絕對風險和相對風險。
text.en: PRS results are usually expressed as relative risk (e.g., >3-fold versus the rest of the population); the authors note that both absolute and relative risks must be assessed and communicated.

text.zh: PRS 的權重（effect weight）來自最有檢定力的 GWAS 所估計的效應量（或 Z 分數），並以 summary statistics 形式取得。
text.en: PRS weights come from effect size estimates (or Z-scores) of the most powerful GWAS, obtained as summary statistics.

claims.missing_evidence: No source in the corpus reports outcome evidence (e.g. randomized trials) that PRS-guided screening reduces disease incidence or mortality. Not shown on the site until such evidence is ingested.

text.zh: 以 PRS 引導的篩檢可降低疾病發生率或死亡率。
text.en: PRS-guided screening reduces disease incidence or mortality.

text.zh: 相較單一體學研究，多體學提供理解疾病背後「資訊流動」的機會；常見體學包含基因體、轉錄體、蛋白體與代謝體等。
text.en: Compared with single-omics studies, multi-omics offers the opportunity to understand the flow of information underlying disease; layers include the genome, transcriptome, proteome and metabolome.

text.zh: 多體學整合可從不同起點出發：genome first 從 GWAS 位點開始探究其致病機制，phenotype first 從其他層次出發，另有 environment first；並非只有一條固定路徑。
text.en: Multi-omics integration can start from different points: genome-first starts from an associated locus to find mechanisms, phenotype-first starts from another layer, and there is also environment-first — there is no single fixed path.

evidence.location: Main text, section on integration approaches

text.zh: TCGA 在 DNA、RNA、蛋白質與表觀遺傳層次分析大量腫瘤；Pan-Cancer 計畫比較了最先完成的 12 種腫瘤類型。
text.en: TCGA profiled large numbers of tumours at the DNA, RNA, protein and epigenetic levels; the Pan-Cancer initiative compared the first 12 tumour types.

claims.note: Stated as an aim of the Pan-Cancer project, not a demonstrated result.

text.zh: TCGA Pan-Cancer 的目標之一，是將對某癌症有效的療法延伸到具相似基因體特徵的其他癌症（屬研究目標，非已證實結果）。
text.en: One aim of TCGA Pan-Cancer is to extend therapies effective in one cancer type to others with a similar genomic profile (a research aim, not a demonstrated result).

text.zh: RNA-seq 分析常包含功能分析（例如 gene set enrichment analysis），並可與其他功能基因體技術整合。
text.en: RNA-seq analysis commonly includes functional analysis (e.g. gene set enrichment analysis) and can be integrated with other functional genomics techniques.

text.zh: 基因分型晶片促成大規模 GWAS，全轉錄本測量方法則催生了「integrative genetics」，為多體學奠定基礎。
text.en: Genotyping arrays enabled large-scale GWAS and methods for global transcript levels gave rise to integrative genetics, the foundation of multi-omics.

text.zh: eQTL mapping 將基因型與基因表現量連結，是 RNA-seq 分析的步驟之一，也是 Mutation/變異資料與 RNA Expression 整合的典型例子。
text.en: eQTL mapping links genotype to gene expression; it is one of the RNA-seq analysis steps and a typical example of integrating variant data with RNA expression.

text.zh: 精準醫療是一種新興的疾病治療與預防方式，考量每個人在基因、環境與生活型態上的差異，有別於針對「平均的人」設計的一體適用策略。
text.en: Precision medicine is an emerging approach to disease treatment and prevention that takes into account individual variability in genes, environment and lifestyle, unlike one-size-fits-all strategies designed for the average person.

text.zh: 美國 Precision Medicine Initiative（2015）的近期重點是癌症，長期目標是產生適用於所有健康與疾病的知識。
text.en: The US Precision Medicine Initiative (2015) had a near-term focus on cancers and a longer-term aim to generate knowledge applicable to the whole range of health and disease.

text.zh: ACMG 強烈建議臨床分子遺傳檢測在 CLIA 認證實驗室進行，結果由具專科認證的臨床分子遺傳學家或同等專家判讀。
text.en: ACMG strongly recommends that clinical molecular genetic testing be performed in a CLIA-approved laboratory, with results interpreted by a board-certified clinical molecular geneticist or equivalent.

text.zh: Khera 等人主張可以開始考慮將多基因風險預測納入臨床照護；在冠狀動脈疾病中，高 PRS 族群的盛行率是具同等風險之罕見單基因突變攜帶率的 20 倍。
text.en: Khera et al. proposed that it is time to contemplate including polygenic risk prediction in clinical care; for coronary artery disease, the high-PRS group was 20-fold more prevalent than carriers of rare monogenic mutations with comparable risk.

text.zh: 要實現公平的 PRS 應用，遺傳研究必須優先提升族群多樣性，並公開 summary statistics，避免擴大對弱勢族群的健康不平等。
text.en: To realize the equitable potential of PRS, genetic studies must prioritize diversity and publicly share summary statistics so that disparities are not increased for underserved groups.

text.zh: 癌症基因體研究比較不同腫瘤譜系的分子異常，以建立共通性、差異與新主題的整合圖像。
text.en: Cancer genomics compares molecular aberrations across tumour lineages to build an integrated picture of commonalities, differences and emergent themes.

text.zh: 大多數常見疾病具遺傳成分，且多數疾病風險本質上是多基因的；但表現型同時受環境因素影響。
text.en: Most common diseases have a genetic component and most disease risk is polygenic in nature, while phenotype is also shaped by environmental factors.

topic.zh: PRS 是否已可進入臨床照護
topic.en: Is PRS ready for clinical care?

positions.S20: Proposes it is time to contemplate including polygenic risk prediction in clinical care.
positions.S18: Clinical use of current PRS may exacerbate health disparities because accuracy is several-fold higher in European ancestry.
positions.S17: Utility is debated; evidence supports group-level stratification.

conflicts.factors: Population: S20 developed and tested in UK Biobank participants of British ancestry only (409,258), so its performance claims do not speak to other ancestries; S18 explicitly evaluates cross-ancestry accuracy. Design: S20 is a single-cohort development/validation study; S18 is a perspective synthesizing multi-ancestry analyses; S17 is a review. Outcome: S20 reports relative-risk stratification, not clinical outcome benefit.
conflicts.handling: Both positions are shown side by side. Claims are classified separately (S20 single_study; S18 consensus with S24 support; overall utility = uncertain). The site states that PRS performance depends on ancestry and that outcome benefit is not established (C-PRS-12 pending). No single conclusion chosen.

topic.zh: 表現量單位：RPKM/FPKM 與 TPM

positions.S10: RPKM is inconsistent among samples; TPM should be used instead.
positions.S09: RPKM/FPKM/TPM are within-sample normalized measures; read counts alone cannot compare samples and normalization choice depends on the scenario.

conflicts.factors: S10 is a theoretical argument about one property (average invariance); S09 is a broad best-practice survey covering many quantification scenarios. Neither claims TPM alone is sufficient for between-sample differential expression.
conflicts.handling: Wiki teaches TPM as a within-sample relative abundance measure with its limitation, and points to count-based models (DESeq2, S11) for differential expression. Not presented as 'TPM solves normalization'.
